title: RouterProvider
summary: Provide the router to components and manage browser lifecycle.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: router is a stable instance from createRouter or createDataRouter. children contains the route renderer and shared layout. Data-specific hooks require createDataRouter.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Do not recreate the router during render. Multiple providers can share a router: start reference-counts history listeners. Provider cleanup detaches its lifecycle subscription; use router.dispose when discarding the router itself.
